// =============================================================================
// Spring Boot Integration Regression Test Templates
// =============================================================================
// Use these templates when test_level is "integration" or "both".
// Integration tests use *IT.java suffix and are run via Maven Failsafe or
// Gradle integrationTest task.
//
// This file contains THREE template variants — use the one matching the
// Spring component type under test.
// =============================================================================


// =============================================================================
// VARIANT 1: @WebMvcTest — Controller Integration Regression
// =============================================================================
// Use for: @RestController, @Controller
// Dependencies: spring-boot-starter-test (included by default)
// =============================================================================

package {{PACKAGE}};

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Nested;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Tag;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Autowired;
import org.springframework.boot.test.autoconfigure.web.servlet.WebMvcTest;
import org.springframework.boot.test.mock.bean.MockBean;
import org.springframework.http.MediaType;
import org.springframework.test.web.servlet.MockMvc;

import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.MockMvcRequestBuilders.*;
import static org.springframework.test.web.servlet.result.MockMvcResultMatchers.*;
import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*;
import static org.mockito.Mockito.*;

@WebMvcTest({{CLASS_NAME}}.class)
@Tag("regression")
// {{OPTIONAL_REQUIREMENT_TAG}} @Tag("{{REQUIREMENT_ID}}")
@DisplayName("Regression: {{CLASS_NAME}} integration — {{CHANGE_DESCRIPTION}}")
class {{CLASS_NAME}}IT {

    @Autowired
    private MockMvc mockMvc;

    @MockBean
    private {{DEPENDENCY_TYPE_1}} {{DEPENDENCY_NAME_1}};

    @MockBean
    private {{DEPENDENCY_TYPE_2}} {{DEPENDENCY_NAME_2}};

    @Nested
    @DisplayName("{{ENDPOINT_METHOD}} {{ENDPOINT_PATH}} — behavior preservation")
    class EndpointBehaviorTests {

        @Test
        @DisplayName("still returns expected status code for valid request")
        void testEndpoint_validRequest_returnsExpectedStatus() throws Exception {
            // Arrange — mock service layer
            // when({{DEPENDENCY_NAME_1}}.method(any())).thenReturn(expectedValue);

            // Act & Assert
            // mockMvc.perform(get("{{ENDPOINT_PATH}}")
            //         .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON))
            //     .andExpect(status().isOk())
            //     .andExpect(jsonPath("$.field").value(expectedValue));
        }

        @Test
        @DisplayName("still returns 404 for non-existent resource")
        void testEndpoint_notFound_returns404() throws Exception {
            // when({{DEPENDENCY_NAME_1}}.findById(anyLong())).thenReturn(Optional.empty());

            // mockMvc.perform(get("{{ENDPOINT_PATH}}/999"))
            //     .andExpect(status().isNotFound());
        }

        @Test
        @DisplayName("still validates request body")
        void testEndpoint_invalidBody_returns400() throws Exception {
            // mockMvc.perform(post("{{ENDPOINT_PATH}}")
            //         .contentType(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)

    @Nested
    @DisplayName("{{ENDPOINT_METHOD}} {{ENDPOINT_PATH}} — response structure")
